=== about
A signals patch, then defaults that only fill the keys that are missing.
=== input
event: ypy-patch-signals
data: signals {"name":"Ana","online":3}

event: ypy-patch-signals
data: onlyIfMissing true
data: signals {"theme":"light"}

=== signals
{"patch":{"name":"Ana","online":3},"onlyIfMissing":false}
{"patch":{"theme":"light"},"onlyIfMissing":true}
